enforced.claim: A red job blocks the merge
enforced.mechanism: ruleset "Green Main" requires `gate`; `gate` runs last with `if: always()` and needs the 8 jobs `lint-test`, `Golden Vectors`, `Python/Rust Parity`, `Kani BMC`, `Mutation Testing`, `Examples`, `Contract Validation`, `Lean Proofs`
enforced.red_when: any needed job failed, was cancelled or was skipped
enforced.plant: a failing step in Kani BMC, not the first job: lint-test green, kani red, `gate` red, merge BLOCKED
enforced.limit: Org admins may bypass the ruleset ("always"), and the account that merges here is one. No merge used it: every blocking check was green before each merge ([audit](docs/ontology-conformance.md#findings))

enforced.claim: Each example receipt conforms to its closed SHACL shape
enforced.mechanism: `pv lint --gate shapes` over 12 shapes and 12 focus nodes (the 11 example receipts and this table); the Examples job diffs each receipt against `evidence/examples/`
enforced.red_when: any shape violation, or a receipt that differs from its tracked evidence
enforced.plant: examples/integrate.json receipt edited to hold false: Examples red (falsify_exintg_002 receipt differs from evidence), `gate` red
enforced.limit: Checks the 11 examples on their fixed inputs, not the library on other inputs

enforced.claim: The ONT-G contracts gate runs every step
enforced.mechanism: `scripts/contracts_gate.sh`: 6 steps, each RUN with its own status
enforced.red_when: any step fails; the later steps still run
enforced.plant: four faults in one run (phantom baseline, README byte, claims plant run, receipt): 4 of 6 steps failed and all 6 RAN, `gate` red
enforced.limit: pv is the instrument: its defects pass through ([aprender#4531](https://github.com/paiml/aprender/issues/4531), [aprender#4521](https://github.com/paiml/aprender/issues/4521))

enforced.claim: README.md is generated: every byte comes from `docs/README.md.in` and the ontology
enforced.mechanism: `scripts/readme_sync.sh --check` regenerates the whole file and compares bytes; `scripts/example_links.sh` checks every example link
enforced.red_when: any README byte differs from the regenerated file; a link whose target does not say what the link claims
enforced.plant: one README byte hand-edited (`enforced` to `enforceD`), nothing else: only Contract Validation red (readme step), `gate` red
enforced.limit: The prose in `docs/README.md.in` is written by hand: the gate proves the README matches it, not that the prose is true

enforced.claim: Every claim in this table conforms to its closed SHACL shape
enforced.mechanism: this table is rendered from `evidence/enforcement/claims.json`, closed by `contracts/enforcement-claims-v1.yaml`; the generator also checks each claim's job against `scripts/ci_gate.sh`
enforced.red_when: an enforced claim with no plant run; an advisory check presented as enforced; a claim whose job `gate` does or does not need contrary to its class
enforced.plant: the advisory PMAT claim moved into `enforced` in claims.json: the shape names `job: "comply" is not one of [...]`, Contract Validation red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: The shape checks that a plant run is recorded, not what the run showed: the run itself is the receipt

enforced.claim: Proof levels only rise; phantom Kani references only fall
enforced.red_when: a level drops, or phantoms exceed 28
enforced.plant: phantom baseline lowered from 28 to 27: the ratchet reports phantoms rose from 27 to 28, Contract Validation red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: Levels today: 1 at L2, 21 at L3, 1 at L5. pv credits a declared harness toward L3 without checking that it exists

enforced.claim: Bounded properties hold for every input within the bound
enforced.plant: a strict-order assertion added to verify_quicksort_sorted: Kani reports the assertion failed, Kani BMC red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: BOUNDED: unwind 4 to 9, so no loop runs more than 8 times. Nothing is proved beyond the bound. Every declared harness exists for 12 of 22 contracts; 28 declared harnesses are phantoms ([#6](https://github.com/paiml/rust-mdipierro-nlib/issues/6))

enforced.claim: Pre- and postconditions hold at runtime
enforced.mechanism: 10 `contract_pre_*!`/`contract_post_*!` macros, written by hand in `build.rs`, at 11 call sites
enforced.red_when: an assertion panics in a debug or test build
enforced.plant: the quicksort postcondition macro inverted in build.rs: 6 tests panic `postcondition violated`, lint-test red, every other job skipped, `gate` red
enforced.limit: They expand to `debug_assert!`: release builds are NOT checked at runtime. `quicksort: input exists` (`len < usize::MAX`) can never fail

enforced.claim: The tests catch changes to the code a PR touches
enforced.red_when: a mutant on a changed line survives
enforced.plant: an untested function (plant_untested_scale) added: 2 mutants missed, Mutation Testing red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: Code the PR does not touch is not re-checked

enforced.claim: Values match the golden vectors from Python nlib
enforced.plant: the quicksort golden vector first value changed from 3 to 4: golden_sort mismatch, Golden Vectors red, `gate` red

enforced.claim: The Rust values match Python nlib run live
enforced.mechanism: `tests/falsify_parity.py` runs Di Pierro's nlib.py at a pinned commit against `cargo run --example parity`
enforced.red_when: any value differs beyond its tolerance
enforced.plant: Rust integrate scaled by 1.01: integrate_sin 2.02 against Python 1.99997, Python/Rust Parity red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: Parity cannot catch a bug the two implementations share

enforced.claim: An equation is true on every input of an exact model (L4)
enforced.mechanism: `scripts/lean_gate.sh` in the Lean Proofs job: `lake build` of `lean/` with the pinned toolchain and Mathlib; `pv` counts 9 theorems there grounded in a contract, and the contracts ratchet fails if that count falls ([#5](https://github.com/paiml/rust-mdipierro-nlib/issues/5))
enforced.red_when: a proof that does not check; any `sorry`, `admit`, new `axiom` or `native_decide`; a cited theorem that does not exist or that `lake build` never compiles
enforced.plant: transpose_transpose restated as `(Aᵀ)ᵀ[i,j] = A[j,i]` plus a `sorry` in simpson_exact_cubic: `lake build` unsolved goals and `declaration uses sorry`, the static check names the sorry, Lean Proofs red, `gate` red
enforced.limit: Each theorem is about an exact model (reals, lists in a linear order, row-major arrays), NOT the f64 code: [docs/lean-proofs.md](docs/lean-proofs.md) states each gap. At L4 or above: `statistics-v1` (L5); the other contracts have obligations no theorem covers, and Fourier, random and Monte Carlo are N/A

not_enforced.claim: The whole library survives mutation testing
not_enforced.mechanism: the full `cargo mutants` sweep on `main`, a step with `continue-on-error: true`
not_enforced.red_when: never blocks: it runs after the merge
fails today, and `gate` does not need it
not_enforced.limit: Its failures are governance (branch protection needs an admin, `deny.toml`, `build.rs`, roadmap and spec schema, TDG), not contract enforcement
